# Environment variables

| Variable | What it does |
|---|---|
| `NO_COLOR` | turn colour off (any value but empty); status is still shown in words and glyphs |
| `COLORTERM` | truecolor or 24bit tells Centcom the terminal can show 16 million colours |
| `CENTO_MASCOT` | on or off: show or hide Cento |
| `CENTO_REDUCE_MOTION` | 1 turns animation off |
| `CENTO_SPINNER` | fun or plain words next to the spinner |
| `CENTO_THEME` | dark, light or auto |
| `DO_NOT_TRACK` | 1 turns telemetry off, whatever else is set |
| `CENTCOM_TELEMETRY` | on or off (off always wins) |
| `CENTCOM_CONFIG_DIR` | where config.json lives |
| `CENTCOM_STATE_DIR` | where saved conversations, caches and logs live (default ~/.centcom) |
| `CENTCOM_API_URL` | the backend address (for development against the mock) |
| `CENTCOM_RELAY_URL` | the relay address (for development against the mock) |
| `CENTCOM_LOG_LEVEL` | debug, info, warn, error or silent |
